comments.body:
## Evidence correction — CoinGecko ID

The canonical CoinGecko page is already an active tracked listing with a rank, circulating/total supply and the Raydium DASHA/WSOL market. Its current CoinGecko ID/path is:

`dash_eats`

Correct evidence URL:

https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/dash_eats

The issue body’s `/coins/dash-eats` URL is incorrect and should not be copied into the CoinMarketCap application. CoinGecko currently maps the exact mint `53uxQtB9pcjWvCHguz3JTTndvuKqGxhrD37EetnCpump`, getdasha.com, Solscan and the Raydium market. Use the active listing as independent identity/market evidence.

This does not replace the CoinMarketCap request; CoinMarketCap remains a separate free new-listing form. Before submitting, open the exact-mint search on CMC first in case a preview page has appeared since this packet was written.
